Reference image for [[Jokes#Frozen Assets|Jokes]] entry on [[Frozen Assets]]: the prop of Han Solo frozen in carbonite from ''The Empire Strikes Back'' (1980), shown at the Star Wars Identities exhibition at the O2, London, in 2017.
